name: Scripture
author: David JM
description: Shows a random Scripture verse on the full-screen dark scrim Omarchy's speed tests use. ESV, World English Bible, or King James Version; ESV when an api.esv.org key is set, WEB and KJV are keyless.

barWidget.description: One bar icon that shows a random Bible verse centered on a full-screen dark scrim — no card, like the Omarchy speed tests. Esc, the scrim, or the icon again closes it. Cred: also jump to a reference, history back/forward, favorites, a fixed verse of the day, and daily auto-open.

schema.label: ESV API key (api.esv.org)
schema.description: Free key from api.esv.org (Create Application). Enables the English Standard Version. Leave empty to fall back to the World English Bible via bible-api.com.

schema.label: Translation
schema.description: ESV needs the api.esv.org key above; WEB (World English Bible) and KJV (King James Version) are keyless via bible-api.com. If ESV is chosen without a key, WEB is shown instead.

schema.label: Fixed verse (overrides random)
schema.description: e.g. John 3:16. When set, the overlay always opens to this reference instead of rotating, and the bar icon's hover tooltip shows it. Leave empty for the random no-repeat rotation.

schema.label: Auto-open daily at (HH:MM)
schema.description: 24-hour time, e.g. 07:30. The verse overlay opens by itself at that time each day. Leave empty to disable.
